title: How I Used Claude and Git Hooks Together to Build a Generic AI Agent for HATEOAS APIs
html:
How I Used Claude and Git Hooks Together to Build a Generic AI Agent for HATEOAS APIs

Claude wrote nearly all of it, mostly from my dictation. Git hooks kept it honest, one behavior at a time.

Borrowed Built for
say: Have you ever asked an AI agent to do the same job twice and gotten two different answers? This talk is about how I stopped that, in two places at once. In how the agent works: ARTIE, a generic agent for hypermedia APIs. And in how it was built: Claude wrote nearly all of it, mostly from my dictation, and git hooks kept it honest, one behavior at a time. We'll follow one small, real example the whole way: a library's renewal policy, from one sentence I said, to a release that catches a bad policy before it reaches anyone.
